decisions.story_title: Windows NCSI proxy authentication coercion 0-day (ZDI-26-708) published, unpatched
decisions.reason: Researcher Pedro Gabaldon publishes two-part technical analysis of ZDI-26-708 / ZDI-CAN-29849 (CVSS 5.3): an unprivileged user's proxy configuration makes NCSI (ncsi.dll in netprofm) authenticate via NTLM from the NETWORK SERVICE context, i.e. the machine account on domain-joined hosts, to an attacker-controlled proxy, enabling relay chains to ADCS or RBCD. Microsoft declined a CVE and the issue is unpatched; verified at pgj11.com with ZDI advisory reference. Primary researcher disclosure, not commentary.
